name: Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sudo chown node:node /workspace/node_modules "$npm_config_store_dir" && COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 pnpm install && mkdir -p ~/.claude && ([ -f ~/.claude/settings.json ] || cp .devcontainer/claude-settings.container.json ~/.claude/settings.json) && sudo sh -c 'rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/*; echo "node ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/bin/init-firewall.sh" > /etc/sudoers.d/node-firewall; chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/node-firewall'
